article.headline: Swindon Supermarine: from works team to Southern League
paragraphs: Club roots: The modern Swindon Supermarine club was founded in 1992 through the merger of Swindon Athletic and Supermarine, two clubs with Hellenic League histories.
An aviation connection: The Supermarine side grew from the Vickers Armstrong works social club in 1946, a name connected with the aircraft manufacturer famous for the Spitfire.
Moving forward: After progressing through local football, the merged club built a sustained Southern League presence. A memorable promotion in 2017/18 took Marine back to Premier Division South.
Back at Step Four: Following relegation from the Southern Premier Division in 2024/25, Marine returned to Division One South and began a rebuilding programme under Bobby Wilkinson.
A changing home: The ground in South Marston was known for years as Webbswood Stadium, but its current sponsored name is the Imagine Cruising Stadium.
Building again: The club's 2025/26 review described an improved second half of the season after a difficult start, with development of younger players a particular positive.
